title: The shockwave a Starship launch sends through the sky
title_candidates: A GoPro strapped to a camera caught what Starship does to the sky
What actually happens to the air when Starship lifts off
The shockwave a Starship launch sends through the sky
How a GoPro caught something most Starship launch footage misses
The part of a Starship launch most cameras are too far away to see
caption:
When a rocket this big launches, it compresses the air around it into visible waves that travel outward at the speed of sound. Most cameras at a Starship launch are set too far back to show this. This GoPro, clamped right next to a proper camera near the pad, caught it in 4K.

The photographer ran both cameras simultaneously to get two views of the same moment. This is what the GoPro picked up.
